name: MessageStore
summary: Collects information about every message in one place, so that a transient and loosely coupled system can be reported on without being made less transient or less loosely coupled.

roles.name: MessageStore
roles.summary: Where a duplicate of each message, or a few fields of it, is kept for later analysis. It is fed and forgotten so the main flow is not slowed, at the cost of traffic — which is why what it keeps is a decision rather than an oversight, and worth being able to find.
